name: Apple
why: Powerful ecosystem, services growth, cash generation, and institutional support.
warning: Its enormous size and premium expectations can limit surprise upside.

name: NVIDIA
why: AI and data-center leadership, revenue acceleration, margins, and sector dominance.
warning: Expectations are extremely high, so pullbacks can be violent.

name: Monster Beverage
why: A durable brand, distribution strength, category expansion, and long-term compounding DNA.
warning: Mature-category growth and valuation can slow the climb.

name: Amazon
why: AWS, advertising, logistics scale, and improving operating leverage.
warning: Capital intensity, regulation, and consumer sensitivity remain meaningful.

name: Tesla
why: Innovation history, brand strength, software ambition, and volatility-driven opportunity.
warning: Margins, competition, execution risk, and sentiment swings remain substantial.

name: Netflix
why: Global scale, pricing power, advertising optionality, and improving cash generation.
warning: Content costs and subscriber expectations can punish weak quarters.

name: Advanced Micro Devices
why: Product execution, CPU and GPU exposure, data-center opportunity, and turnaround DNA.
warning: Competition and semiconductor cyclicality remain real.

name: Costco
why: Membership economics, customer loyalty, steady comps, and durable operating discipline.
warning: Premium valuation can reduce future returns even when the business performs well.

name: Vertiv
why: Data-center infrastructure demand, power and cooling exposure, and strong thematic tailwinds.
warning: A crowded AI-infrastructure trade can create sharp resets.

name: Axon Enterprise
why: Recurring software, connected devices, public-safety adoption, and ecosystem expansion.
warning: Valuation and government procurement cycles can create volatility.

name: Deckers Outdoor
why: Brand momentum, strong margins, disciplined distribution, and category expansion.
warning: Fashion cycles and high expectations can change quickly.

name: Wingstop
why: Asset-light expansion, unit growth, strong brand awareness, and franchise economics.
warning: Valuation, food costs, and consumer traffic remain risks.

name: Meta Platforms
why: Advertising scale, engagement, AI-driven efficiency, and powerful cash generation.
warning: Regulation, capital spending, and platform shifts remain important.

name: AppLovin
why: Software growth, advertising optimization, strong market momentum, and margin expansion.
warning: Expectations, concentration, and rapid sentiment changes can amplify downside.

name: Microsoft
why: Cloud scale, enterprise distribution, recurring revenue, AI integration, and cash flow.
warning: Its size, valuation, and heavy capital spending raise the performance bar.
